paragraphs: In Gittin 89b, he treated Rav Ashi’s daughter, and she was healed.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source cites Gittin 89b and gives the heading רבין דמן גרש (Ravin of Garash). The matching treatment of Rav Ashi’s daughter is at 69b in the William Davidson vocalized text, which names רבין דמן נרש (Ravin of Naresh). The source’s locator and name form are retained; this does not establish whether the differences originated in print or transcription.

The saved Davidson Gittin69b scalar has Ravin of Naresh treating Rav Ashi’s daughter, who recovered. Hyman has Garash and89b; those supplied forms remain in heading and body. The differences’ origin in print or transcription is not established. Initial ב is In, not the older enumeration2; the actor is supplied contextually from the heading. Rav Ashi is explicit; Ravin is a name without an added personal title. No medical detail is imported.
